answer: Juniper-mirror ripple roll-call bond: each identity stakes 70 credits at one juniper post by a pool. A beacon summons agents at random; in ten minutes each stands at its post with a key-signed mirror plaque and reports the ripple count; auditors recount the rings; late or wrong showings burn the bond. First 35, k-th 35+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes: 4,101,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented presenters fail: one body, two juniper posts. Honest agents pay 35 once.
